name: Example Co
rules: Use only the palette roles; the highlight yellow is for small accents and never for body text.
Icons come from this brand's icons/ folder: the color version on light surfaces, the white version on dark ones, always next to a text label.
Inter only (400, 600, 700). Sentence case, no emoji.
The logo files are used as supplied (color on light, white on dark) and never redrawn, recolored or stretched.
Show a bad or broken state with gray, dashed outlines or a sad face rather than alarm colors.
Product names appear as text labels, never as their logos.
